newsitem.title: USA: Compass Bancshares buys Florida banks.
newsitem.headline: Compass Bancshares buys Florida banks.

text.p: Compass Bancshares Inc said Monday it had bought CFB Bancorp Inc and its Community First Bank subsidiary, the largest acquisition it has ever made in Florida.
Compass said CFB would bring $313 million in assets and $262 million in deposits to its franchise in the state.
In addition to Jacksonville locations, CFB operates two bank offices in the Hernando County community of Spring Hill, it said.
Compass said the acquisition would increase its assets in the state by 50 percent.
It said it had exchanged 1,326,154 common shares for all outstanding CFB Bancorp common shares and unexercised stock options.

With the pending acquisition of Enterprise National Bank of Jacksonville scheduled to be finalized by the end of the year, Compass said it would have more than $1.1 billion and 36 bank offices in Florida.
It said 23 of the locations will be in the Jacksonville area, where it will have about 7.0 percent of the deposit market share and rank as the third largest bank in terms of deposits.
